01 · The list

Every word,
in exam order

Levels 5 and 6 are the top of TOPIK II: news, academic and professional Korean, and the nuance of formal writing. The National Institute of Korean Language publishes the advanced vocabulary as one band for both levels. This page holds that band: 2,561 words, which Lock&Learn Korean splits by frequency into the Advanced 1 and Advanced 2 packs. Every entry shows the hangul, its Revised Romanization and an English meaning.

In Lock&Learn Korean this list is the Advanced 1 and Advanced 2 packs: a word waits in hangul with its romanization; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. Advanced 1 and Advanced 2 open with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Type to filter by hangul, romanization or meaning. Flashcards hides the meaning until you tap a row; Shuffle deals the list in a new order.

04 · Questions

Asked and
answered

How many words are in the TOPIK II Advanced vocabulary list?

2,561. The National Institute of Korean Language grades its learner vocabulary as beginner, intermediate and advanced rather than by TOPIK level. The beginner band, which is the TOPIK I vocabulary, holds about 1,800 words; the intermediate and advanced bands about 2,150 and 2,550.

Is this the official TOPIK Levels 5 and 6 word list?

TOPIK itself publishes no vocabulary list. This page follows the National Institute of Korean Language (NIKL) learner vocabulary, the list TOPIK preparation is built on, in the TOPIK II Advanced band. The English meanings are Lock&Learn glosses, not an official translation.

How do I study the TOPIK II Advanced list on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Korean, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Korean. The Advanced 1 and Advanced 2 packs put these words on the widget one at a time: you recall the meaning, one tap reveals it with a real sentence. Advanced 1 and Advanced 2 open with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Can I download the TOPIK II Advanced vocabulary list as a PDF?

Yes. Use your browser's Print or Save as PDF: the page has a print layout that keeps only the heading and the full table, every word on this list.

Is Lock&Learn Korean free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: Beginner 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
